q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Short answer — performance fell sharply this week vs last week, and the data points to lower ad activity (esp. on Meta) plus worse on-site conversion and lower order value as the main contributors.

Key numbers (previous then current; percent change)
- Net sales: ₹356,317 → ₹133,397 (−62.6%) — Measured  
- Orders: 188 → 71 (−62.2%) — Measured  
- Ad spend: ₹215,617 → ₹88,849 (−58.8%) — Measured  
- Net profit: ₹-19,773 → ₹2,273 (improved ₹22,046) — Measured  
- Conversion rate: 1.1% → 0.8% (−24.1%) — Measured

Why (likely causes, labelled)
- Lower ad spend (Measured): Spend fell ~58.8%; less investment reduces attributed traffic and orders. Tag: Hypothesis (supported by measured spend drop).  
- Meta platform pullback (Measured): Meta spend/revenue dropped materially (diagnosis: Meta went from ~₹135,640 → ₹54,144 and accounts for ~68% of the net-sales change). Tag: Hypothesis (measured segment move — plausible driver).  
- Specific ads stopped (Measured): Several ad names that previously drove revenue went to ₹0 (e.g., TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE, TH-222-WINGBIRD). Tag: Hypothesis (these ad-level drops line up with the platform fall).  
- Lower order value (Measured in diagnosis): Order value fell ~43% per-day; that amplifies the drop even if order count falls. Tag: Hypothesis.  
- Falling conversion rate (Measured): Site conversion down ~24% — fewer visitors convert. Tag: Hypothesis.

Confidence and notes
- The period totals and component splits are exact; upstream causes are plausible but not proven (diagnose compared the periods and flagged the segments above; it did not label a single supported_cause). Today's data is partial; queries refreshed ~2026-10-13T19:03 IST.
